items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Carol’s is in psychology... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, in Florida.

ctx.x: In what, if I may ask?
Carol’s is in psychology, and Lydia’s was in education. Some kind of... I don’t remember exactly what it was. In other words, she was a procurer for teachers down in Broward County.
